name: rp-vllm
launch: docker rm -f sglb70-vllm >/dev/null 2>&1; VEXTRA='--enable-prompt-tokens-details' bash ~/sglb70/exl3xpu/scripts/sglb70_vllm.sh && for i in $(seq 200); do curl -sf -m 5 http://127.0.0.1:8110/v1/models >/dev/null && exit 0; docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -q sglb70-vllm || exit 1; sleep 5; done; exit 1

cells.cmd: docker exec sglb70-dev python3 /w/replay/replay_bench.py --url http://127.0.0.1:8110 --exp rp-vllm --engine vllm --cells 1 --replay /w/replay/omp_replay_corpus.redacted.filtered.jsonl --ledger /w/ledger.jsonl --runs /w/replay/runs --card $(basename $(readlink -f /dev/dri/by-path/pci-0000:84:00.0-card))  --note 'paired 84:00.0 2026-09-26'
